mapper.select: SELECT uf.id as attentionId, uf.follower_id as followerId, -- 被关注者ID u.id as userId, -- 被关注者的用户ID u.user_id as userUid, -- 被关注者的UID u.nickname, u.avatar_url as avatarUrl, uf.create_time as createTime FROM user_follow uf RIGHT JOIN user u ON uf.following_id = u.user_id -- 关联被关注者的信息 WHERE uf.follower_id = #{follower} -- 关注者ID = 当前用户 ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC;
